name: The Sweet Spring (Cam Tuyền Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each heal you cast while above 80 % linh lực overflows, and the overflow becomes a ward worth half the heal. When you have held full linh lực for 3 s, your next heal is doubled.

story: The founder's needles, the gourd of the true spring and the robe of the red dawn. The head holds all three. It is the healers' set, not the cellars', and she means the school to remember the difference.

name: The Hundred Jars (Bách Úng Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: a foe carrying six or more of your Water stacks gains one Drunk stack each pulse while it stays at six or more.

story: The cellar's seal, the cask and the apron. The wine-master holds all three. They are worth more to Kim Vạn Lý than to the school, and he knows it.
